sources.title: GLM-5.2 — Z.ai LLMs model | Heyaiwiki
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2, released June 13 2026 by Z.ai (formerly Zhipu AI), is the year's open-weight leader for long-horizon coding. It's a 753-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (~40B active) and, for the first time in the GLM line, delivers its capability on a stable 1M-token context — enabled with the glm-5.2 [1m] identifier — all under a pure MIT license with no regional limits.
